authorization: User authorized continued bounded local M5 training; no paid calls or remote4070 execution.
task: Restore one source-observed alphabetic word of at least four letters, represented by one to three canonical tokens, from visible left/right context. Target absent as a whole word from the full input.
reward: Complete exact target and EOS; no case/whitespace normalization, partial-prefix reward or learned judge.
sampling: Work-balanced fixed prompt order shared by branches; at most eight nonoverlapping windows per work; no resampling to force mixed reward groups.
comparison: Same warm-start adapters, fresh AdamW states and same 64-prompt order/LR. ContinuedCE makes 64 updates; DrGRPO attempts 64 groups of four responses and skips no-signal updates. Prompt-budget matched, not compute matched.
evaluation: Fixed endpoints: base, warm, continued CE, RL. Primary accuracy is the unweighted mean of per-work exact-match rates. Content NLL averages target-token NLL within each example, then examples within each work, then works; EOS NLL, invalid/truncated rates secondary. Report both seeds; no best-checkpoint selection.
test_policy: Never load test/quarantined book contents into this task builder or model runtime. No old pilot work reused.
limitations: Children’s prose lexical reconstruction, not book-field/mood/recommendation quality.
Exposure of the pretrained base to these works is unknown.
One on-policy update per fresh group keeps importance ratios near one; this is not multi-epoch PPO.
